### A Fishy Story
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/a-fishy-story-homeword-december-7.html
Passage: Jonah 2:7
Points:
- Human pride often deceives people into thinking they can resolve their messes alone.
- People tend to turn to other people or worldly advice instead of immediately seeking the Lord.
- Believers should run to God as their first resort in trouble rather than treating Him as their last option.
- No matter how deep or dark the circumstances are, it is never too late to pray and ask God for help.

### The Depths of Mercy
Author: Annah Mathews
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-february-19-2018.html
Passage: Jonah 2:1-2
Points:
- God extends mercy and listens to desperate cries even when trouble is caused by personal disobedience.
- Severe trials can serve as divine intervention to spare a person and redirect their path.
- Receiving God's help requires letting go of self-justification, pride, and lingering anger.
- God readily offers forgiveness and grants another opportunity to walk forward in obedience.
